Its technology combines artificial intelligence, proprietary transaction data, and VIN-based vehicle information to provide businesses with reliable pricing recommendations and condition assessments for used vehicles.

about_short_description.short_description: AlgoDriven is an automotive technology company that provides AI-powered vehicle data intelligence and car valuation software.

product.name: EvalExpert
product.description: A fully automated vehicle appraisal tool providing price guidance and vehicle analysis on a single platform.

product.name: DriveExpert
product.description: A platform to manage test drives, loan/service cars, and staff vehicles with license scanning and fleet management features.

product.name: DealExpert
product.description: A tool to reduce finance paperwork and optimize the process of completing auto loan deals for dealerships.

product.name: Axle Inspect
product.description: Customizable vehicle inspection software for identifying, inspecting, and reporting vehicle damage and stock status.

product.name: AlgoDriven Insights
product.description: A data analytics service providing vehicle value analytics, market value trends, future value forecasts, and competitor analysis.

product.name: Vehicle Spec Data
product.description: A comprehensive database of vehicle specifications, descriptions, and model codes for vehicles sold in the GCC region since 2012.
